messages.subject: Calculating Dhat4 (activityOverlap)
parts:
Dear Juergen, deal all
it looks like that when the number of events is higher than 50, Dhat4 is better than Dhat1. If I am not wrong, the "activityOverlap" function only prints Dhat1 in the plot, right? Is there a way to have get the Dhat4 value directly from camtrapR? The overlap package lets computing Dhat4 (although not from the "overlapPlot" function, but using the "overlapEst" function). 

Thanks a lot!!
Bernat

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: Calculating Dhat4 (activityOverlap)
parts:
Hi Bernat,
currently camtrapR only returns Dhat1 and you need to use overlapEst from the overlap package to compute Dhat4. 
The next version will contain the option to choose. Thank you for the suggestion.
Best regards,
Jürgen
